stories.title: Afghanistan sweep aside complacent Bermuda
stories.subTitle: Afghanistan v Bermuda, World Cup Qualifiers, Potchefstroom
stories.summary: Afghanistan's unquenchable confidence drove them unerringly to a convincing 60-run win over Bermuda, condemning them to their second loss in as many days

stories.title: USA defeat Canada to move within sight of title
stories.subTitle: ICC Americas Division 1
stories.summary: On the fourth day of the ICC Americas Division 1 Championship, USA beat Canada to move within one match of the title, Bermuda beat Argentina and Cayman Islands defeated Suriname
